facts.business: WeWork India Management Limited operates as a full-stack workspace platform providing flexible workspace solutions, enterprise-grade infrastructure, hospitality-led member experience, integrated design and build solutions, and technology-enabled operations across multiple cities in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capitalisation from CWIP to Property, Plant and Equipment

facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Ind AS financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards. During FY25, the Company entered into an agreement with Embassy Services Private Limited for acquisition of Fitouts for a consideration of Rs 101.69 million.
